verdict.rationale: Self-evaluation before committing is supported: there is a playground (docs-36), pay-per-page API pricing at $4/1000 pages (docs-42), and per-word, block, or page confidence scores (docs-19). Community testers ran their own head-to-head trials (comm-1, comm-3, comm-4). Published benchmarks are only indirectly evidenced, through a tester's remark that 'benchmarks are impressive' (comm-4); no vendor benchmark tables, methodology, datasets or reproduction scripts appear in the pack. missing for 10: first-party published benchmark results with methodology, reproducible eval datasets/scripts, an official eval tooling or free-tier trial description, independent reproduction of vendor numbers.
